content: You cannot protect yourself from sadness without protecting yourself from happiness.
author: Carl Jung
sourceWork: The Archetypes and the Collective Unconscious
story:
Following his bitter break with Sigmund Freud in 1913, Swiss psychiatrist Carl Jung entered a prolonged confrontation with his own unconscious at his lakeside sanctuary in Küsnacht. Recording his visions in the famed Red Book, Jung mapped the universal archetypes, shadow instincts, and the individuation journey required to integrate one's hidden depths into psychological wholeness.

Exploring the mysteries of human connection, Carl Jung saw that genuine fulfillment cannot be hoarded or manufactured through egoic control. It blossoms only when we lower our defenses, dissolve self-importance, and meet the world with openhearted generosity.
reflectionPrompt: Who in your life needs your unconditional support or appreciation today without any transaction?
